chunks: And it is narrated from Bakkār ibn Kardam, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man meets a woman and says to her, "Marry me to yourself for a month," but he does not specify the month itself; then he meets her after years.
So he عليه السلام said: "He has his month if he had specified it; and if he had not specified it, then he has no claim over her."

key_terms.الشَّهْرَ: The particular month intended in the agreement
key_terms.سَبِيلَ: A legal claim or right of recourse
key_terms.شَهْرًا: A month as the stated term of the contract
key_terms.نَفْسَكِ: Your person; meaning herself in the marriage contract

ai.seo_question: Is a temporary marriage valid if the specified month is not clearly identified?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding temporary marriage (mutʿah) when a duration is mentioned ambiguously. The Imam عليه السلام states that the man's claim only stands if the month was specified; otherwise, the contract has no enforceable basis over the woman.
